claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated using metrics such as BLEU scores for machine translation and word error rates for automatic speech recognition.
Quality checks for translations indicate that no poor quality translations were found according to established criteria, supporting the dataset's reliability.
Initial benchmarks and evaluation data are provided to assess the quality of the CoVoST dataset.
